# openmetadata_table (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata table by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_table" "users" {
  fully_qualified_name = "warehouse.analytics.public.users"
}

output "users_table_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_table.users.id
}

output "users_columns" {
  value = [for column in data.openmetadata_table.users.columns : column.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Table fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Table UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `columns` (Attributes List) Ordered columns of the table. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--columns))
- `database_schema` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent database schema.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Table name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

<a id="nestedatt--columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `columns`

Read-Only:

- `data_length` (Number) Length for character and binary column types.
- `data_type` (String) OpenMetadata column data type.
- `description` (String) Markdown description of the column.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable column name.
- `name` (String) Column name.
- `ordinal_position` (Number) One-based position of the column.
- `precision` (Number) Numeric precision.
- `scale` (Number) Numeric scale.
